{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows persistent negative signals (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-14 day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment shifts from positive to neutral/negative (e.g., 0.00 → -0.20).",
    "Avoid overreacting to early sentiment spikes — delay correction until 2-3 consecutive days of negative sentiment.",
    "For long-term horizons (>14 days), reduce forecast volatility by smoothing with 30-day moving average.",
    "If sentiment is consistently positive (0.00 or 0.33) but price is trending down, reduce forecast by 3-5% to avoid overconfidence."
  ]
}
